Name: Ilucie's Elliott Reskin by variavi
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Okay guys - I use this portrait mod since it came out (in my personal mod collection I created from old XNB files before CP was a thing) and I LOVE IT SO MUCH that I needed to upload it for you. 

The assets aren't mine. The original author is [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/variavi]variavi [/url](here) and [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/elliott-reskin-no-more-christmas-fabio.110288/]PixelViolation [/url]on Chucklefish. She gave the permission to upload/edit/use the assets if proper credits are given.

So: NOT MINE. Except the code, all the changes to Elliott belong to variavi.

I hope you like him as much as I do <3!

requires SMAPI and Content Patcher



for Stardew 1.6+
